forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: Welcome to The AI Edge, folks. We've got a packed episode. Starting with Microsoft's Q1 performance—a 22% jump in Azure, and Copilot's invasion continues. Then, AI runtime security, Anthropic's bold ambition to be the AWS of agentic AI, and Utah's medical board calling to shut down an AI pilot. Hang tight, 'cause it's gonna be a ride.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: [sharp exhale] And speaking of bold, SiliconANGLE's piece on AI runtime security has me on edge. If these systems aren't secure, we're talking catastrophic business failures.

forwardable_moments.speaker: RUFUS
forwardable_moments.text: [scoffs] Because human doctors never make mistakes, right? The real issue here is trust. The board doesn’t trust AI with life-and-death decisions.

forwardable_moments.speaker: ALEX
forwardable_moments.text: That's the billion-dollar question. And what about these agentic AI ambitions? Anthropic aims to be the AWS of AI. How does that shake the market?
